name: Interleukin production restraint with IL-10 induction and IL-12 suppression
rationale: All members regulate T cell-linked cytokine output (IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21, TNF, Th1, Treg); unlike the closest confusables it includes positive IL-10 and negative IL-12 production rather than IL-27/IL-35 signaling, direct T cell proliferation suppression, or IL-1 beta control.

qualifier: heavy metals and aryl hydrocarbon receptor ligands
name: Response to heavy metals and aryl hydrocarbon pollutants
rationale: Members are responses to lead, mercury, cobalt, pesticides and dioxin via AhR; confusables centre on ethanol, nicotine, bisphenol or iron/selenium rather than heavy metals and AhR ligands.

qualifier: heme B via protoporphyrinogen IX, supporting hemoglobin
name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrinogen IX
rationale: All members concern porphyrin/heme B synthesis and its regulation for hemoglobin, including mitochondrial heme-pathway transporters; confusables add heme A synthesis, iron-sulfur clusters, or heme/iron uptake.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification plus MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation
name: Epidermal keratinocyte cornification and MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope, skin barrier and hair follicle together with MITF-M, melanin and melanocyte programmes; confusables have only pigment granules, ectodermal appendages, or intestinal epithelium.

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glucose metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA control of hepatic glycogen and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate
rationale: Members span glucagon/PKA signalling, glucokinase, glycogen turnover and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis; confusables emphasise insulin signalling, glycolysis enzymes, glycogen storage diseases or gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: FSH-responsive somatic and germ cell development
name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-responsive gonadal development
rationale: Members regulate FSH/LH secretion and FSH-driven Sertoli, seminiferous tubule, follicle and germ cell development; confusables centre on activin/follistatin, LH/GnRH responses, or Leydig cells and meiosis.

name: Complement activation, its regulation and hypersensitivity responses
rationale: Members are classical, lectin and alternative complement activation, MAC and opsonization control plus ADCC and hypersensitivity; confusables are Fc receptor/phagocyte signalling or antimicrobial neutrophil defence.

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glycogen metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA and glucokinase control of hepatic glycogen
rationale: Members cover glucagon/PKA signalling, glucokinase-GKRP, glycogen breakdown and synthesis regulation; confusables add glucose-6-phosphate disorders, triglyceride/PDE3B or gluconeogenesis rather than glucagon-PKA plus glucokinase.

qualifier: organic anion and cation carriers at barriers
name: Organic anion and cation xenobiotic transport across barriers
rationale: Members are sodium-independent organic anion/cation and xenobiotic transport including blood-brain barrier export and drug ADME; confusables centre on hepatic SLCO bilirubin handling or polyamine transport.

qualifier: receptor-level control including IL-1, IL-37 and CD40
name: Receptor-level regulation of Toll-like, IL-1 and CD40 signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR/MyD88, IL-1 receptor, IL-37 and CD40 signalling at the receptor level; confusables cover downstream TRIF/TAK1 events or inflammatory cytokine production.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine signaling and cAMP suppression
rationale: Members are muscarinic Gi/Gq signalling plus PDE1 activation and cAMP catabolism; confusables involve adrenergic, serotonin or nicotinic receptors or cAMP synthesis.

name: Macrophage NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and anti-inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members concern NADPH oxidase superoxide generation in macrophages with CD163 and FCGR3A-IL10 anti-inflammatory and pathogen-damping responses; confusables centre on neutrophil killing or hydrogen peroxide handling.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors with quiescence control
name: Thyroid and retinoid nuclear receptor signaling and quiescence
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone, retinoic acid and estrogen nuclear receptor regulation plus G0/G1 transitions; confusables emphasise liver development, steroid sex-hormone responses or TGF-beta-driven arrest.

name: Iron homeostasis via transferrin uptake and heme scavenging
rationale: Members cover transferrin cycling, iron import and export defects, and plasma heme scavenging; confusables involve cadmium, copper/manganese, heme synthesis or oxygen sensing.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte extravasation and diapedesis
rationale: Members are neutrophil and T cell extravasation, diapedesis and integrin-based migration; confusables focus on chemotaxis, chemokines or endothelial adhesion.

name: Cytochrome P450 steps of adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are pregnenolone, glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis, ferredoxin electron supply and CYP enzyme defects; confusables cover sex steroid synthesis or regulation of secretion.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte and erythroid differentiation, RUNX1 control and platelet morphogenesis; confusables are earlier myeloid progenitors, late erythroid only, or other RUNX1 targets.

name: CRH-corticosterone driven behavioral stress and drinking responses
rationale: Members are behavioural stress, fear, CRH and corticosterone responses with drinking and ethanol behaviour; confusables are hormone secretion, social behaviours or neuropeptide signalling.

name: Cardiac calcium-release control with negative inotropy and chronotropy
rationale: Members regulate cardiac SR calcium release, relaxation, membrane potential and decreased contraction and heart rate; confusables are skeletal muscle, positive inotropy or conduction coupling.

name: HGF-MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET/HGF and MST1 signalling cascades plus hepatocyte differentiation, liver morphogenesis and regeneration; confusables share kinase cascades but lack the liver context.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, FLT3 and G-CSF receptor signalling via STAT5 and CBL; confusables cover IL-3/IL-5, PDGFR or TKI-resistant mutants.

name: Hexose absorption, glycogen metabolism and their inherited disorders
rationale: Members span dietary sugar digestion and hexose transport, fructose, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen with storage diseases; confusables lack intestinal absorption or glycogen and add pentose/galactose or glucagon control.

name: Cellular osmotic stress responses and epithelial salt transport
rationale: Members are hypo- and hyperosmotic and salt stress responses, water homeostasis and renal sodium/chloride transport; confusables centre on specific cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium or aldosterone.

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT and PDGFR mutants
rationale: All members are KIT or PDGFR mutants binding or resisting TKIs; confusables involve FLT3, ALK or FGFR mutants or KIT signalling without drug resistance.

name: Mitochondrial heme biosynthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members are heme A/B synthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, the two iron cofactor pathways; confusables are respiratory chain, steroid electron transport, erythrocyte gas transport or iron uptake.
